idea-plugin.name: etcd
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and edit an etcd v3 cluster from inside the IDE.
  • Keys — browse the key space as a tree, read and edit values with syntax highlighting, create and delete keys, and delete or export a whole prefix.
  • Watch — stream live PUT and DELETE events for a key or prefix.
  • Leases — grant, renew, inspect and revoke leases, with the keys attached to each one.
  • Cluster — member list, endpoint status, alarms, compaction and defragmentation.
  • Auth — manage users, roles and permissions, and toggle authentication.
Connects over etcd's v3 gRPC-gateway (HTTP/JSON), supporting anonymous access, username/password authentication, TLS with a custom CA, and client certificates (mTLS). The plugin bundles no third-party libraries.
